title: HR Project Coordinator - Immediate Start
description:
HR Project Coordinator / People Projects Coordinator

L&D Compliance HR Projects People Operations

18 an hour 4-6 Month Contract Onsite Crawley with Hybrid Flexibility

Are you an organised HR professional with experience supporting HR projects, learning & development, compliance, and people operations? We are looking for a confident and proactive HR Project Coordinator to join a busy People team during an exciting period of change and development.

Working closely with HR Business Partners and key stakeholders, you'll play a pivotal role in coordinating people-focused initiatives, ensuring compliance processes run smoothly, and supporting a range of HR and L&D projects.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate and support a variety of HR and People projects across the business
- Work closely with HR Business Partners to deliver organisational initiatives and employee programmes
- Support Learning & Development (L&D) activities, including training administration, scheduling, communications, and reporting
- Monitor and maintain HR compliance, ensuring employee records, documentation, and policies remain up to date
- Assist with onboarding, inductions, and employee lifecycle processes
- Track project milestones, actions, and deadlines, ensuring timely delivery
- Produce reports and analyse HR data to support decision-making
- Coordinate employee communications and stakeholder engagement activities
- Support change management and continuous improvement initiatives across the People function

About You
- Previous experience in a HR Coordinator, HR Project Coordinator, HR Administrator, People Coordinator, HR Officer, or L&D Coordinator role
- Experience supporting HR projects, people initiatives, organisational change, or transformation programmes
- Strong understanding of HR compliance and employee administration
- Exposure to Learning & Development processes and training coordination
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Confident communicating with stakeholders at all levels
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
- High attention to detail and a proactive approach

Ideal Background

We would love to hear from candidates with experience in:
- HR Projects
- People Operations
- Learning & Development
- HR Compliance
- Employee Engagement
- Organisational Change
- Talent Development
- Workforce Planning
- HR Administration
- People Services

What's on Offer?
- 4-6 month contract opportunity
- Hybrid working available after training and onboarding
- Exposure to a wide range of People and HR projects
- Opportunity to work alongside experienced HR Business Partners in a collaborative team

title: Onboarding Coordinator
company: UK Power Networks (Operations) Ltd - Company - Contract
description:
Onboarding Coordinator

Crawley 12-month fixed-term contract Circa 29,750 + 7.5% bonus

Make every new starter's first experience count

Join our HR Services Onboarding Team at Energy House and help deliver an accurate, efficient and welcoming journey for new employees. From offer through to day one, you'll play a key role in making sure people feel informed, supported and ready to succeed.

What you'll do
- Prepare contracts and appointment letters and maintain accurate candidate records.
- Coordinate pre-employment screening, references and right-to-work checks.
- Set up permanent and agency workers in SAP and process employee changes.
- Keep new starters and hiring managers updated, agreeing start dates and coordinating induction activity.
- Manage onboarding enquiries and provide accurate information ahead of payroll deadlines.
- Protect confidential data, follow audit requirements and identify practical process improvements.

What you'll bring
- Experience delivering a responsive, professional service to customers, candidates, colleagues or stakeholders.
- Strong organisation, data-entry and proofreading skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage several priorities, maintain clear records and meet deadlines.
- Confident written and verbal communication, including knowing when to escalate an issue.
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and the discretion to handle sensitive information appropriately.
- A collaborative approach, with the confidence to work independently and take ownership.

Experience in administration, HR, recruitment, onboarding or an HR system such as SAP would be useful, but it is not essential. If you meet the essential criteria and can demonstrate relevant transferable skills, we encourage you to apply.

What we offer

Alongside a starting salary of circa 29,750 and a 7.5% bonus, you'll receive 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, a generous pension, employee discounts, discounted gym membership, wellbeing support and access to tax-efficient schemes including Cycle to Work, Home & Tech and Green Car Leasing.

Ready to apply?

This is a 12-month fixed-term personal contract, with the possibility of becoming permanent. You'll report to the Onboarding Team Leader and must be available to start on 18 January 2027 to support a handover.

Apply by 9 November 2026 and help us create a positive start for every new colleague!

For more information and to view the full job description please click apply!

If you have any queries in connection to this vacancy or your application, please contact us at quoting the vacancy reference number and a member of the team will get in touch with you as soon as possible.

title: Recruitment Officer
description:
Recruitment Officer

Full time - 35 Hours P/W - Monday - Friday

3 Month Temporary

15.56 Per Hour

Brighton - BN3

Tate are recruiting for a highly organised and customer-focused Recruitment Officer to join our Recruitment Team. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in delivering an efficient, inclusive and compliant recruitment and onboarding service that supports the council in attracting talented people from diverse backgrounds.

As a Recruitment Officer, you'll be at the heart of the recruitment journey, supporting managers, candidates and colleagues across the organisation. From advertising vacancies and coordinating recruitment campaigns to producing contracts and ensuring compliance checks are completed, you'll help deliver a seamless recruitment experience for everyone involved.

What you'll be doing
- Managing recruitment and onboarding administration activities from vacancy approval through to appointment.
- Producing contracts and maintaining accurate employee records across recruitment, HR and payroll systems.
- Providing advice and guidance to managers on recruitment processes, advertising and inclusive hiring practices.
- Supporting compliance activities including right to work checks and recruitment process requirements.
- Acting as a first point of contact for recruitment and onboarding enquiries, handling complex issues with professionalism and sensitivity.
- Building positive relationships with a wide range of stakeholders across the council and externally.
- Delivering training and guidance to managers and colleagues on recruitment systems and processes.
- Contributing to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance recruitment procedures and service delivery.
- Analysing recruitment data and supporting reporting requirements.

What we're looking for

We're keen to hear from candidates who can demonstrate:
- Previous experience providing high-quality administrative support within a busy, fast-paced environment.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
- Strong attention to detail and confidence working with data and computer systems.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- A customer-focused approach with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently using initiative.
- Experience using Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
- The ability to build effective working relationships across a diverse organisation.
- An interest in recruitment, onboarding and delivering an excellent candidate experience.

If you have the suitable skills and experience, please apply today!

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Temporary HR & Operations Coordinator
description:
Temporary HR & Operations Coordinator

Bodiam, East Sussex
15.00 - 16.00 per hour
Full-Time 40 Hours Per Week

Immediate start pending DBS check

Are you an organised and proactive administrator with experience across HR, operations, compliance, or office management? Do you enjoy working in a varied role where no two days are the same? We are supporting a well-respected educational organisation in Bodiam to recruit a key role in the smooth running of the school.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys balancing people-focused HR responsibilities with broader business operations, compliance, facilities coordination, and administration.

The temporary position may suit someone looking for an interim role or who wants to work whilst applying for permanent opportunities. This role could also become permanent after a period of temping.

The Role

Working closely with the Bursar, you will provide administrative and operational support across a range of functions including:
- Coordinating recruitment, onboarding, and employee lifecycle activities
- Managing HR records, employee files, and compliance documentation
- Supporting payroll administration and HR systems
- Monitoring safeguarding, DBS, right-to-work and pre-employment checks
- Coordinating meetings, events, room bookings, and internal communications
- Liaising with external suppliers, contractors, and service providers
- Supporting health & safety processes, audits, inspections, and compliance activities
- Managing venue hire bookings and acting as a key contact for external users
- Preparing reports, maintaining records, and supporting operational projects
- Identifying opportunities to improve systems and business processes

About You

We are looking for a highly organised and professional individual who can confidently manage multiple priorities whilst maintaining excellent attention to detail.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience within HR, business operations, office management, or a similar coordination role
- Strong administrative and organisational skills
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
- Experience using Microsoft Office and HR systems
- The ability to handle confidential information with discretion
- Knowledge of employment legislation, safeguarding, or compliance processes
- A proactive and adaptable approach with a positive, can-do attitude

Desirable
- CIPD qualification (or working towards)
- Experience working within education or another regulated environment
- Payroll administration experience
- Knowledge of Health & Safety requirements
- Project coordination experience

What's on Offer?
- Competitive hourly rate of 15.00 - 16.00 per hour
- Varied and rewarding role with excellent exposure across HR and operations
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Opportunity to make a real impact within a busy and successful school

Please note: The successful applicant will be subject to enhanced DBS and safeguarding checks in line with safer recruitment requirements.

Why Temporary Work?

Keep Earning
Maintain a regular income while searching for your ideal permanent position.

Enhance Your Skills
Gain exposure to new systems, processes and industries while keeping your CV current.

Expand Your Network
Meet new employers and build valuable professional connections.

Access Exclusive Opportunities
Many of our temporary assignments lead to permanent positions or open doors to future opportunities.

Support Throughout Your Search
We're here to help every step of the way, from finding assignments to securing your next permanent role.
